notes.title: Five Years In Strange - The Real Texas 5 Year Anniversary Sale
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25637114/5fb045a58393806e68e2e87dda325b8e150ce373.png

Hey Everyone!

It's hard to believe but The Real Texas was out five years ago last week. I'm still incredibly proud of it; I can't really put it words how fulfilling it is to hear from people who enjoyed it in the past or are still discovering it now.

To celebrate, I'm putting it on sale:


 The Real Texas is 55% off
 Cellpop Goes Out At Night (which is about one year old now) is 11% off
 The Dusty Skies Edition (includes both games) discount stacks with this, too!


I don't do this too often, and this is the cheapest it's been (or will be) in a long time, so if you are curious-- now's a good time to scoop it up! Or, if you've already visited Strange, tell your pardners if you think it's up their alley.

To everyone who has played it and enjoyed it over the years-- a sincere thank you from this cowboy right here!

Calvin

P.S.: O yeah... remember it's never too late to leave a Steam review and say what you think!

notes.title: Version 1.6 Update (Mac and Windows); Linux version soon
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25637114/7b9d9430a95b0509222889d39fd998a7e50b9a64.png

Hooray! I've released a patch, called version 1.6, this evening.

It fixes a fairly bad crash bug that would have happened to everyone after a long enough play session.

Incredibly sorry about this, especially everyone who lost progress in the game.. Losing progress is a major bummer and something I work hard to avoid.

Other changes include:


 Game now auto-saves when moving between areas
 Gameplay bugfix for Cellpop
 Sound engine updated (internal fix only; game should sound the same)


Linux version will be up soon; I was hoping this week but I spent more time working on key redeeming than I anticipated so haven't had time to ge this sorted out. 

But the game runs happily in 32 and 64 bit flavours of Linux-- it's coming! One or two outstanding issues, but I'm still going to try and get it up this week, but it might have to wait until next week.
